entities.summary: The Islamic Republic of Iran Navy, also referred as the Iranian Navy, is the naval warfare branch of Iran's regular Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, formed after the 1979 revolution, also has a Navy.
